About the Role (Job Purpose)
We are seeking a QA Manager to help establish and maintain the quality and document-control framework supporting Nordscale’s mission-critical data centre operations. As Nordscale is building its operating organisation, you will have the opportunity to shape practical quality processes, controlled documentation and ways of working from an early stage.

You will ensure that operational and technical information is controlled, traceable, approved, accessible and audit-ready, while helping the organisation identify and implement the quality management arrangements required by applicable customer, contractual and regulatory requirements.

Working closely with Operations, Engineering, the Process Specialist and other technical functions, you will provide quality governance around procedures, records, changes and non-conformities. Technical and operational owners remain accountable for technical content, approvals and corrective work.
What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities)
• Help establish and continuously improve the quality and document-control framework across operations, maintenance, engineering and compliance.
• Manage controlled documents throughout their lifecycle, from creation and approval to publication and archiving.
• Maintain document registers, standards and traceability across controlled information.
• Govern document control for SOPs, MOPs, EOPs and technical work instructions.
• Coordinate audit readiness and ensure relevant evidence and records are available and traceable.
• Define and maintain the requirements and processes for managing non-conformities and corrective actions.
• Ensure operational changes are documented, approved and reflected in controlled documentation.
• Monitor quality and compliance trends to identify areas for improvement.
• Work with Operations and Engineering to embed practical quality controls.About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)
You may come from quality assurance, quality systems, document control or compliance in data centres, energy, oil and gas, industrial plants, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing or another technically complex and audited environment.

You combine strong structure and attention to detail with enough technical understanding to work credibly with engineering and operations teams. You are comfortable helping to build fit-for-purpose quality processes in an organisation that is still developing its systems and ways of working.
Key Characteristics
• Structured and rigorous, with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through.
• Comfortable challenging gaps in process or evidence while working constructively with operational teams.
• Collaborative and pragmatic, able to translate quality requirements into workable practices.
• Analytical and improvement-oriented, using findings and trends to prevent recurrence.Skills & Qualifications
• Relevant experience in quality assurance, quality systems, document control or compliance within a technical or regulated environment.
• Strong understanding of document control, revision management, traceability, compliance and audit requirements.
• Experience establishing, implementing or improving practical quality processes and controlled documentation.
• Good digital skills and experience with electronic document or quality management systems.
• Strong interest in exploring and applying LLMs to improve workflows, processes and quality.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Ability to work on-site in Bjerkvik, outside Narvik.Nice to Have
• Experience from data centres or other mission-critical infrastructure.
• Experience supporting ISO 9001 or comparable management systems; exposure to ISO 27001, ISO 14001 or ISO 45001 is also relevant.
• Experience with SOP, MOP and EOP governance in live technical operations.
• Experience from engineering, maintenance or asset-management environments and the handover of as-built, O&M or commissioning documentation.
• Good written and verbal communication skills in Norwegian.What We Can Offer You
• Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
• The opportunity to shape the quality framework and operating standards of a growing AI infrastructure environment.
• A cross-functional role with close exposure to Operations, Engineering and technical specialists.
• Relocation support assessed individually, if required.Equal Opportunities Statement
We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.
Application and Contact
Apply by submitting your CV through the application portal. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Build the Future of AI Infrastructure in Northern Norway
jobs.description:
About the Role (Job Purpose) 

We are seeking an Operational Process Specialist to strengthen the performance, resilience and continuous improvement of mechanical, electrical and process systems in a mission-critical data centre environment. 

In this role, you will take ownership of operational procedures and help ensure they reflect the technical environment, operational best practice, and the way work is carried out in practice. You will work closely with Operations, Engineering and technical specialists to improve processes and support safe, efficient and reliable operations. 

This is an opportunity to help shape the procedures and technical standards behind a growing AI infrastructure environment, with broad exposure across disciplines and a clear impact on day-to-day operations. 

 

What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities) 

• Analyse and optimise the performance of mechanical, electrical and process systems. 
• Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency, resilience and operational performance. 
• Own the technical and operational content of procedures and support their implementation in day-to-day operations. 
• Develop and improve the technical content of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Methods of Procedure (MOPs), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs) and work instructions together with relevant specialists. 
• Collaborate with Operations, Engineering and technical specialists to ensure critical infrastructure operates safely, efficiently and within design parameters. 
• Support change management by assessing operational impacts and validating process changes before implementation. 
• Review operational data, completed work, deviations and current practices to identify improvement opportunities. 
• Provide technical input to audits, compliance activities and continuous improvement programmes. 
About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience) 

You may currently be working in technical operations, facilities, maintenance, process improvement or engineering support, with experience from data centres or another technically complex environment such as industrial plants, energy facilities, oil and gas, pharmaceuticals or manufacturing. 

You have broad technical understanding and enjoy working across disciplines, understanding how systems interact and finding practical ways to improve their operation. You do not need to be a specialist in every discipline. What matters is that you see the bigger picture, work effectively with technical specialists and take a structured approach to processes, quality and documentation. 

 

Key Characteristics 

• Passionate about operational excellence and continuous improvement. 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach. 
• Calm under pressure and able to make informed decisions within mission-critical environments. 
• Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail. 
• Collaborative and able to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering and operational teams. 
• Proactive, self-motivated, and committed to delivering high operational standards. 
• Safety-focused with a strong understanding of critical infrastructure risk management. 
Skills & Qualifications 

• Relevant experience operating, maintaining or optimising mechanical, electrical or process systems. 
• Broad technical understanding and the ability to see how different systems interact. 
• Experience from technical environments where reliability and operational continuity are critical. 
• Experience developing or improving operational procedures and technical work instructions. 
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English. 
• Ability to work on-site in Bjerkvik, outside Narvik. 
Nice to Have 

• Experience with SOPs, MOPs, EOPs or similar operational procedures. 
• Experience with process optimisation, continuous improvement or monitoring/BMS systems. 
• Experience from data centres, industrial plants, energy facilities, oil and gas, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing or similar technically complex environments. 
• Relevant technical education or qualifications; equivalent practical experience is also valued. 
What We Can Offer You 

• Competitive salary negotiable based on experience. 
• Performance-based bonus tied to results and company performance. 
• The opportunity to influence operational processes, procedures and technical standards in a rapidly scaling AI infrastructure environment. 
• A cross-disciplinary role combining technical understanding, process optimisation and continuous improvement. 
• 
Relocation package if required. 

 

Equal Opportunities Statement 

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. 

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds. 

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know. 

 

Application and Contact 

Apply by submitting your CV through the application portal. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Researcher in Mooring Design and Analysis for Offshore Floating Solar Farms
jobs.description:
About the position
A fixed-term 100% researcher position is available at the University of Agder, Faculty of Engineering and Science as a Researcher in Structural Engineering, affiliated to the Department of Engineering Sciences, for a period of 2 years. The position is located at Campus Grimstad.  The starting date is Spring 2027. 

The Department of Engineering Sciences has more than 90 employees in scientific positions, and more than 1500 students at all levels. A variety of research is conducted within all the groups; Mechatronics, Renewable Energy, Civil Engineering and Industrial Economy, and we also welcome interdisciplinary projects within the department or with other research groups. This position will be associated with the Civil Engineering section. We have a broad international cooperation, and close collaboration with industrial partners and public services in the region. This is a benefit both for teaching and research. The partners contribute with assignments, competence and resources.Project Background

As one of the projects successfully funded by the CETPartnership, HelioSea aims to develop and demonstrate an innovative floating photovoltaic (FPV) concept for marine environments. The technology integrates a tension-leg platform, dual-axis solar tracking, and intelligent operational control. Through the design, deployment, and monitored operation of a pilot system, the project aims to advance the concept from Technology Readiness Level (TRL) 3 to TRL 5.
Responsibilities
The researcher will contribute to the work package focused on advancing offshore solar farms. The work package involves five project partners and includes the following tasks:

• Numerical modelling of shared mooring configurations;
• Wave-basin testing of FPV farms;
• Analysis of FPV farms co-located with floating breakwaters; and
• Assessment of farm-level energy production and power performance.
The focus of this position will be the design of shared mooring and cable layouts. The researcher may also support experimental testing and pilot activities. The work will include dynamic response analyses, covering both hydrodynamic and aerodynamic effects, as well as structural integrity analyses.

The researcher will collaborate closely with project partners, including partners from Spain and Portugal, to carry out the project activities. The research will involve preparing and submitting project reports and high-quality scientific publications, as well as contributing to dissemination activities at the European level.
Required qualifications
• A PhD in marine technology, civil engineering, mechanical engineering, or another relevant field. Applicants must have had their doctoral thesis approved by the application deadline.
• Expertise in at least one of the following areas: Fluid dynamics; Design of marine structures; Offshore multibody structures; Multiphysics simulation of marine and offshore structures; Experimental analysis of marine structure.Desired qualifications
• A strong record of high-quality scientific publications;
• Strong programming and analytical skills; and
• Experience working collaboratively in international research projects.
Emphasis will be placed upon the project description and the relevance it has with regard to the subject in question and the research environment at the Faculty. 

Personal qualities and suitability for the position will be emphasised.
We offer
• professional development in a large, exciting and socially influential organisation 
• a positive, inclusive and diverse working environment 
• modern facilities and a comprehensive set of welfare offers  
• membership of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
More about working at UiA.

The position is remunerated according to the State Salary Scale, salary plan 17.510, code 1109, NOK 680 000 – 730 000,- gross salary per year. Higher salary grades may be considered for particularly well-qualified applicants. A compulsory pension contribution to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund is deducted from the pay according to current statutory provisions.
General information
UiA is an open and inclusive university. We believe that diversity enriches the UiA is an open and inclusive university. We believe that diversity enriches the workplace and makes us better. We, therefore, encourage qualified candidates to apply for the position independent of gender, age, cultural background, disability or an incomplete CV. The successful applicant will have rights and obligations in accordance with the current regulations for the position, and organizational changes and changes in the duties and responsibilities of the position must be expected. The engagement is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning the acts relating to Control of Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Appointment is made by the University of Agder’s Appointments Committee for Teaching and Research Positions.  

A background check may be conducted to verify information that appears in available documents. Background checks are always done with the applicant's consent, and employment in the position requires an approved background check. Relevant applicants will receive further information. 

Short-listed applicants will be invited for interviews and a demonstration of their teaching competency, usually in the form of a trial lecture. With permission from the applicant the university also will conduct a reference check before appointment. The final recommendation will be an overall assessment based on the expert assessment, the trial lecture, the interview(s) and references. Read more about the employment process.  

In accordance with the Freedom of Information Act § 25 (2), applicants may request that they are not identified in the open list of applicants. The University, however, reserves the right to publish the names of applicants. Applicants will be advised of the University’s intention to exercise this right.
Application
The application and any necessary information about education and experience (including diplomas and certificates) are to be sent electronically. Use the link "Apply for this job".

The following documentation must be uploaded electronically: 

• Transcripts from PhD, master, and bachelor studies with grades

Game communities are where players make friends, build worlds and create together. Most of the harm in them comes from a handful of users. Some are bullies who drive other players away. In a game built for kids, one of them can be an adult pretending to be twelve. Aiba builds the AI that finds them before a moderator has to, so the community stays a safe place to play and create. For studios, that means happier players, higher NPS and lower churn.

Our platform is called Amanda. It moderates chat, voice and images in real time, flags grooming, bullying and fake profiles, and gives moderators the tools to act fast. Teams at MoviestarPlanet, WildWorks and Rovio (Angry Birds) use it to keep their communities safe.

The timing is on our side. Rules like the DSA and COPPA have made online safety a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Game studios and social platforms now have to solve this, and they are coming to us to do it.

We are a small team in Oslo and Gjøvik. We need the person who turns our partners into a steady source of new customers.

The role in short
We have 3 to 5 prospective partners who could bring us customers. Today we don't work with them in a structured way. You change that. You own every partner relationship, build the method for how we work together, and make things happen.

You also measure it. You build the reporting that shows what each partner brings in. When the data shows a partner sends us the right customers, you double down.

What you'll do
• 
Own the relationship with every prospective partner, from the first conversation to a partnership that delivers.

• 
Build our partnership methodology: how we choose partners, work with them and follow up. There isn't one yet.

• 
Set up reporting on the results of the partnership motion, and share it with the team.

• 
Use the data to double down on the partners that bring in ICP opportunities.

• 
Create the content partners need to recommend and sell Amanda.

• 
Keep Aiba top of mind with every partner, so we're the first name they think of.

• 
Run partner events and joint activities that keep the relationships active.

• 
Work closely with sales and marketing, and hand warm opportunities to our Account Executives.

Who you are
• 
You have 2 to 3 years of experience in partnerships.

• 
You can turn a friendly intro into a partnership with real results.

• 
You like numbers. You'd rather show what a partner delivers than talk about it.

• 
You build relationships as easily with suits as with gamers in hoodies.

• 
You act before anyone asks. Low ego, high agency.

• 
You take feedback well, and you have a sense of humor. Both get used here.

• 
Your English is great, spoken and written. More languages are a plus.

A bonus, not a must: startup or scale-up experience, a background in gaming or edtech, or knowledge of Trust & Safety.

Who this isn't for
If you want a partner program that's already built, with a playbook and a manager who plans your week, you won't like it here.

What you get
• 
Starting at NOK 750,000+ base, plus commission paid quarterly

• 
Commission on two things: how partnerships convert into business, and partner engagement, like the partner events you run

• 
Real impact. You build the partner channel from scratch, and in a team this size, it visibly moves the company.

• 
A fast track for your commercial career, in an industry that is growing fast

A product you don't have to oversell. It keeps players safe, kids included.

Conferences around the world, a passionate team, and the usual Norwegian basics: pension, paid holiday and parental leave

Om arbeidsgiveren:
At Aiba.ai, we provide an advanced AI-powered platform designed to elevate player safety by moderating in-game chat in real time. As the gaming industry expands globally, the need for a scalable solution to combat harmful behaviors is critical. Our platform safeguards communities against online threats such as bullying, grooming, racism, radicalization, and other harmful content.

Our AI technology, developed in collaboration with the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), combines machine learning algorithms and behavioral biometrics to ensure fast detection of harmful behavior. We analyze player interactions in real time, identifying threats as they occur, even when players use slang, dialects, or emojis.

Aiba.ai efficiently manages large volumes of player reports, helping developers prioritize critical issues while reducing the burden on moderation teams. This saves time and resources, ensuring swift resolution of urgent matters and improving player experience.

Our platform ensures compliance with key regulatory frameworks, including COPPA and the DSA, protecting players while keeping your game in line with evolving regulations. Our solution also leverages behavioral biometrics to track patterns of behavior, identifying repeat offenders and reducing harmful interactions over time.

Aiba.ai is scalable, supporting both indie games and large multiplayer platforms. Our APIs are customizable and easy to integrate into existing systems, allowing you to tailor moderation based on your needs. Additionally, our platform supports multiple languages, making it ideal for global games with diverse player bases. We provide real-time moderation across languages, ensuring all players are protected, regardless of location or language.

By offering advanced moderation and behavior detection, Aiba.ai helps developers create safer, more enjoyable player experiences. We reduce the burden on moderation teams, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve the health of gaming communities. Our commitment is to provide a robust, scalable solution that protects your players and helps foster a positive gaming environment.

Plukk og pakk, varemottak, lasting og lossing på lager

Pakking, renhold og praktisk hjelp i bakeri og annen produksjon

Bæring, flytting, rigging og praktisk hjelp for sjåfører eller fagarbeidere

Er over 18 år

Er i god fysisk form og ikke redd for å ta i et tak

Kan kommunisere på norsk eller engelsk

Er fleksibel med arbeidssted og arbeidstid 

Gjerne har førerkort klasse B eller truckførerbevis, men det er ikke et krav

Fleksibelt arbeid

Lønn fra 220 kr i timen

Variert arbeid hos ulike bedrifter i Bergensområdet

Arbeidsklær og verneutstyr

Mulighet for flere vakter og lengre oppdrag

Erfaring og referanser du kan bruke videre
